about: Shared test vectors for the Menosan analytics (DEVELOPMENT_PLAN §5.1-§5.4), used by menosan-api and menosan-android. Subcategory codes refer to taxonomy.json (taxonomyVersion). For each case: stats = aggregate(entries); hotspots = findHotspots(stats); comparison = compare(stats, aggregate(previousEntries), previousWeekStart), where an empty previousEntries means nothing was logged in W-1; impacts = measureImpact(adoptions, stats), where adoptions were made on report W-1. Generated by AnalyticsVectorsTest in menosan-api; do not edit expected blocks by hand.

cases.name: single-avoidable-entry
cases.description: One entry is most frequent, highest quantity, and avoidable at once.

cases.name: single-non-avoidable-entry
cases.description: One non-avoidable entry: no AVOIDABLE criterion.

cases.name: only-special
cases.description: Only SPECIAL waste: zero analyzed totals, special line filled, no hotspots.

cases.name: empty-week
cases.description: Nothing logged: zero stats and no hotspots (the server creates no report for this week).

cases.name: ties-ordered-by-code
cases.description: Every subcategory ties on frequency; ties on score break by quantity, then code.

cases.name: cap-of-three
cases.description: Four subcategories tie on every criterion; only the first three by code are kept.

cases.name: avoidable-wins-only-by-score
cases.description: RES_SACHETS is neither most frequent nor highest quantity but is the top avoidable one.

cases.name: top-avoidable-already-a-hotspot
cases.description: The top avoidable subcategory is already most frequent, so only two hotspots.

cases.name: score-and-share-rounding
cases.description: maxF 2, maxQ 16: RES_SACHETS scores (1*16 + 1*2) / 64 = 0.28125, rounded to 0.2813; shares 94.1 / 5.9.

cases.name: share-rounding-half
cases.description: Shares of 6.25% and 93.75% round to 6.3 and 93.8.

cases.name: comparison-with-previous-week
cases.description: Total, all three categories, and subcategories present in either week; deltaPct null when previous is 0.

cases.name: comparison-no-previous-week
cases.description: Nothing logged in the previous week: comparison is null.

cases.name: comparison-previous-only-special
cases.description: The previous week has only SPECIAL waste, so it has no analyzed data: comparison is null.

cases.name: comparison-same-and-negative-half
cases.description: Equal category quantity is SAME with 0.0; -1 of 16 is -6.25%, rounded to -6.3.

cases.name: impact-decreased
cases.description: Target went from 15 to 9.

cases.name: impact-same
cases.description: Target stayed at 4.

cases.name: impact-increased
cases.description: Target went from 2 to 5.

cases.name: impact-target-not-logged
cases.description: Other waste was logged but nothing for the target: follow-up quantity 0, DECREASED.

cases.name: impact-missing-follow-up-week
cases.description: Nothing at all was logged in the follow-up week: no report, so impact is not measured (empty).

cases.name: impact-follow-up-only-special
cases.description: Only SPECIAL waste in the follow-up week still makes a report, so the target counts as 0.

cases.name: full-week
cases.description: Mixed week with special waste, a comparison, and several adoptions (impacts sorted by target, then id).
